audit_items.proof_trace: handle_withdraw refreshes interest (L326), removes ctokens from the obligation's CTokenTable (L328), then calls is_obligation_safe (L332-342) which reads the updated post-withdrawal balance and asserts collateral_weighted_value >= borrow_weight_weighted_debt_value before the transaction can proceed. The assertion at L342 aborts the transaction if the withdrawal would create a shortfall. All user-initiated cToken reductions pass through this single enforced path — confirmed by auditing all callers of withdraw_ctokens in the protocol package.
